note: Operator decisions on comment cases review.md left contradictory or unstated. Expected outcomes in expected-outcomes.json follow these. To be promoted to an ADR when the extraction is built.

decisions.decision: Leading whitespace disqualifies a marker line; trailing whitespace, including \r, is ignored.
decisions.note: Follows the prose's explicit list ("indented ... is not a marker line") over its general "trimmed of surrounding whitespace".

decisions.decision: Sort by created_at; ties keep the tracker's listing order; a missing created_at sorts after every timestamped comment.
decisions.note: The prose is silent on ties and missing values.
The prose makes author preference optional. Faff usually posts as the operator, so authorship cannot tell them apart.

decisions.decision: The region runs from the first open marker line to the first close marker line after it; later markers are ordinary text and are preserved.
decisions.note: The prose defines no pairing; this reading fits "preserve everything after marker_close".

decisions.decision: Lines inside a fenced code block (``` or ~~~) are never marker lines.
decisions.note: Changes the literal line rule, which would adopt a fenced paste; serves the prose's stated aim of rejecting third-party pastes.

decisions.decision:
Text outside the region is kept byte for byte, CRLF included; the region is always written marker_open
body
marker_close. A  before 
 is trailing whitespace of its line, so on a marker line it is rewritten with the region.
decisions.note: The last sentence is the consequence of decisions 1 and 6 together.

decisions.decision: Marker lines stay whole lines: the region runs from the start of the open marker line to the end of the close marker line and is written marker_open\nbody\nmarker_close.
decisions.note: The shape the create step writes; a literal between-markers splice would stop the comment matching on the next run.
